in_marathi.name: Maharana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maharana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maharana is a title given to great rulers, kings, and warriors in Hindu culture. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'maha' meaning great and 'rana' meaning ruler or king.
